verdict.rationale: Hatchet Cloud pricing lists fixed data-retention windows by tier: 3-day on Team and 7-day on the higher tier. Self-hosting the control plane implies the user owns where data lives, but there is no documented, user-configurable retention or deletion control. Missing for 10: configurable retention settings, documented deletion/purge APIs or CLI commands, self-hosted retention configuration docs, and independent corroboration.
